field.label: Enable HMR
field.comment: Serve assets from the Vite dev server. Always forced off in production mode.

group.label: Vite Dev Server
group.comment: Single source of truth for the Vite harness. Run bin/magento mage-obsidian:frontend:dev --sync-env to write these into vite/.env.

field.label: Server Host
field.comment: Host the dev server binds to / is reachable at (e.g. the PHP container name). Maps to VITE_SERVER_HOST.

field.label: Server Port
field.comment: Maps to VITE_SERVER_PORT.

field.label: Secure HMR (wss)
field.comment: Use wss instead of ws for the HMR socket. Maps to VITE_SERVER_SECURE.

field.label: HMR Path
field.comment: WebSocket path for HMR. Maps to VITE_HMR_PATH.

field.label: Public Host
field.comment: Public hostname the browser connects to for HMR (the storefront domain). Maps to MAGENTO_HOST.

field.label: Allowed Hosts
field.comment: Comma-separated hosts the dev server accepts. Maps to VITE_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

field.label: Emit Structured Data (JSON-LD)
field.comment: Auto-emit schema.org structured data (Organization, WebSite, Breadcrumb, Product). Turn off if another extension already provides JSON-LD.

field.label: Emit WebPage Node
field.comment: Emit a WebPage / CollectionPage / ItemPage node carrying datePublished and dateModified, the freshness signals crawlers and answer engines look for.

field.label: Organization Logo
field.comment: Logo for the Organization node (Google knowledge panel). Leave empty to reuse the header logo. Use a square or wide raster image of at least 112x112 px.

field.label: Organization Description
field.comment: One paragraph describing the brand. Falls back to the default meta description when empty.

field.label: Organization sameAs URIs
field.comment: One absolute URI per line: Wikipedia, Wikidata, LinkedIn, Crunchbase, social profiles. These are what let a search or answer engine tie this site to a known entity.

field.label: Contact Point Type
field.comment: schema.org contactType for the phone in Store Information (customer support, sales, technical support...). The contact point is omitted when no phone or email is configured.

field.label: Emit Postal Address
field.comment: Emit the Store Information address as a PostalAddress. Turn off for a store with no public physical location.

field.label: Brand Attribute Code
field.comment: Product attribute holding the brand. Defaults to manufacturer. Leave empty to omit brand.

field.label: GTIN Attribute Code
field.comment: Product attribute holding the EAN / UPC / ISBN. The digit count decides whether it is emitted as gtin8, gtin12, gtin13 or gtin14. Leave empty to omit.

field.label: MPN Attribute Code
field.comment: Product attribute holding the manufacturer part number. Leave empty to omit.

field.label: Item Condition
field.comment: schema.org itemCondition applied to every offer.

field.label: Product Images In Schema
field.comment: How many media gallery images to list on the Product node. Google recommends several aspect ratios of the same product.

field.label: priceValidUntil Horizon (days)
field.comment: Leave at 0 unless you are actually committing to it. An active special price always supplies priceValidUntil from its own end date; this field only applies when there is none, and any value above 0 asserts to Google that your price is guaranteed for that many days. That assertion is yours, not a computed fact — Google treats an invented validity date as misleading markup. Omitting the property only costs a non-blocking warning.

field.label: Checkout Layout
field.comment: Stepped wizard (Identification → Shipping → Payment → Review) or a single-page checkout with every section on one screen.

field.label: Cacheable Checkout Shell
field.comment: Serve the checkout page from the full-page cache, delivering the cart through customer-data instead of inlining it. Off by default. Verify your payment and shipping extensions before enabling; append ?obsidian_shell=0 to any checkout URL to bypass it.

field.label: Defer Scripts In Head Includes
field.comment: Design > HTML Head > Scripts and Style Sheets is a native Magento field, and whoever pastes markup into it owns what that markup does; MageObsidian does not rewrite it on its own. Off by default, and turning it on is a decision about your own content, not a free win. When on, an external <script src> gets defer so it stops blocking the render. That breaks any tag that has to run blocking: A/B testing anti-flicker snippets and consent managers are pasted into this exact field, and deferring them causes the very flash or the late banner they exist to prevent. An external script is left alone when an inline <script> follows it in this field, since that inline tag is usually the call into the library it just loaded — but that check only sees this field, so a caller living in a template, another module or a Page Builder widget is invisible to it. async, defer and type="module" tags, and inline scripts, are never touched. Add data-obsidian-blocking to any tag to keep it exactly as written.

field.label: Defer Stylesheets In Head Includes
field.comment: Design > HTML Head > Scripts and Style Sheets is a native Magento field, and whoever pastes markup into it owns what that markup does; MageObsidian does not rewrite it on its own. Off by default, and turning it on is a decision about your own content, not a free win. When on, every <link rel="stylesheet"> here loads as a preload that is promoted to a stylesheet once it arrives, with a <noscript> fallback. The page paints before that CSS applies, so if the sheet styles anything above the fold the shopper sees a flash of unstyled content and the layout jumps when it lands, which counts against Cumulative Layout Shift. Only turn it on when you know the sheet styles content below the fold or is purely cosmetic. A media="print" sheet is skipped because it never blocks the screen render, and media, integrity, crossorigin, referrerpolicy, id and title are carried over, so Subresource Integrity keeps being verified. Add data-obsidian-blocking to any tag to keep it exactly as written.

field.label: Optimistic UI
field.comment: Apply cart quantity and removal changes in the interface before the server confirms them, reverting with a warning if it refuses. Turn off to wait for the server on every change.

field.label: Preload Eager Island Chunks
field.comment: Announce an eager island's dependency chunks with modulepreload so the browser fetches the graph in parallel. Off by default: on a throttled connection the hints take bandwidth from the largest contentful paint, which is the metric a shopper and a search engine both see. Turn on if your traffic is mostly on fast links and island readiness matters more.
